the pion, kaons and protons are measured in jets of p T = 5–20 GeV/ c from pp collisions at s = 7 TeV with ALICE, with good agreement with the PYTHIA and HERWIG Monte Carlo generators.
The transverse momentum (pT) spectra of charged pions, kaons and protons in jets from pp collisions at s=7 TeV were measured for the first time.

the measurement of the charged pion, charged kaon and proton transverse momentum distributions in charged jets with p T of 5–20 GeV/c from proton-proton collisions at the centre-of-mass energies of 7 TeV.
the production of pions, kaons and protons in jets of hadron collisions at the LHC, which is an important step in the understanding of the hadronisation mechanism.
the production of hadrons in jets from hadronic collisions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the measurements of charged pion and kaon production in jets from pp collisions at the LHC are in agreement with the predictions of the PYTHIA and PHOJET event generators, whereas the measurements of proton production in jets are not.
the measurement is compared to predictions of the Monte Carlo event generators Pythia 6.4, Pythia 8.1 and Herwig 7.0, which are based on the leading order parton shower approach.
the data are well described by Pythia, but not by Herwig++ or EPOS.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we are able to provide the first measurement of p T distributions of pions, kaons and protons in jets from hadronic collisions, and we are able to compare the results with predictions from Monte Carlo models.

the hadronization of a hard-scattered parton in the fragmentation region can be described well by perturbative quantum chromodynamics (pQCD) calculations.
